decisions.decision: Mr. Lincoln suggested that board members think of other projects to discuss at the next COA meeting (re: Eagle Scout project).
decisions.quote: mr. lincoln suggested that board members think of other projects to discuss at the next coa meeting.

decisions.decision: If the Eagle House is closed on the day of a COA meeting, the board will meet the following Tuesday.
decisions.quote: mr. lincoln commented that if the eagle house is closed on the day of a coa meeting, the board will meet the following tuesday.

decisions.decision: Ms. Dwyer asked that copies of the comments and suggestions from the COA board training session be made available.
decisions.quote: jacquelyn dwyer asked that copies of the comments and suggestions made at the training session be made available.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The COA budget is due December 31, 2015; Ms. Doherty said it mostly consists of employee wages, Meals on Wheels driver mileage, and training education fees. No dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: the budget for coa will be due december 31, 2015.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A proper back-up generator for the Eagle House was determined to cost around the figure shown; past generator requests were unsuccessful and DPW runs the Eagle House capital plan.
budget_items.quote: it has been determined that a proper back-up generator for the eagle house would cost around $31,000.

budget_items.topic: Meals on Wheels driver weekly mileage stipend
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Starting January 1, 2016, Meals on Wheels drivers will get a weekly mileage stipend regardless of trips, expected to keep drivers under the income tax threshold.
budget_items.quote: meals on wheels drivers will be paid a weekly stipend of $11.50 for mileage regardless of how many trips they make, which will keep the drivers under the $600 threshold for income tax.

budget_items.topic: Meals on Wheels per-trip pay and 2015 driver earnings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Drivers are currently paid per delivery trip from the Eagle House, and some drivers earned over the stated amount in 2015, leading to income taxation.
budget_items.quote: currently, drivers are being paid $15.00 for each time they deliver meals from the eagle house; therefore some drivers have made over $1,000 in 2015.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Aubuchon said the Eagle House Supporters raised more money this year than in 2014; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: ms. aubuchon commented that the eagle house supporters raised more money this year than in 2014.
